# [cite_start]Rebell Pay - Institutional Standard for Crypto On-Ramp and Off-Ramp 

> Rebell Pay is a professional fintech platform providing liquidity between digital assets and traditional banking systems. [cite_start]It specializes in secure, high-volume exchanges for Individual Investors (HNWI) and Business/OTC clients.

## [cite_start]Core Services 
- [cite_start]**Fiat to Crypto (On-Ramp)**: Fast funding of crypto wallets using SEPA, SEPA Instant, Blik (PLN), and Visa/Mastercard.
- [cite_start]**Crypto to Fiat (Off-Ramp)**: Secure conversion of assets (BTC, ETH, USDC) to bank accounts or cards with full AML documentation.
- [cite_start]**Institutional OTC**: High-volume liquidity without market impact for businesses.
- [cite_start]**Rebell Pay Business App**: 24/7 self-service mobile application for transaction management and live rate tracking.

## [cite_start]Target Audience 
- [cite_start]**Individual Investors (HNWI)**: Focused on discretion, privacy, and documented source of funds (SoF) for large transfers.
- [cite_start]**Business & OTC Clients**: Focused on transparent audit trails, high-volume liquidity, and Web3-friendly banking.
